:::{#sol-matvec-practice}

$\matr{A}$ is $2 \times 3$ and $\vx$ is $3 \times 1$,
so the [matrix-vector product](#def-matvec-mult) is defined and is $2 \times 1$:

$$
\ba
\matr{A}\vx
&= \begin{bmatrix}
2 \cd 1 + 0 \cd 2 + (-1) \cd 3 \\
5 \cd 1 + 3 \cd 2 + 4 \cd 3
\end{bmatrix}
&& \text{(@def-matvec-mult)}
\\
&= \begin{bmatrix} 2 + 0 - 3 \\ 5 + 6 + 12 \end{bmatrix}
&& \text{(multiply)}
\\
&= \begin{bmatrix} -1 \\ 23 \end{bmatrix}.
&& \text{(add)}
\ea
$$

:::
